description: This file defines the 'Money' class, representing monetary amounts with currency data, including methods for arithmetic operations, rounding, comparisons, and currency handling within the Fineract project.

classes.name: Money
classes.description: Represents a monetary amount with associated currency, providing methods for arithmetic, comparison, and currency operations.

methods.name: getCurrency
methods.description: Returns the monetary currency object derived from currency data.

methods.name: getInMultiplesOf
methods.description: Returns the currency's 'in multiples of' value.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Returns the monetary amount as BigDecimal.

methods.name: plus
methods.description: Adds monetary amounts or other Money instances.

methods.name: minus
methods.description: Subtracts a Money amount from this Money.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a Money or BigDecimal amount.

methods.name: divideBy
methods.description: Divides the monetary amount by a value.

methods.name: multiplyBy
methods.description: Multiplies the monetary amount by a value.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this Money with another for ordering.

methods.name: isZero
methods.description: Checks if the amount is zero.

methods.name: isEqualTo
methods.description: Checks if this Money equals another.

methods.name: negated
methods.description: Returns the negation of this Money.

methods.name: abs
methods.description: Returns the absolute value of this Money.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation with currency code and amount.
